decision.title: The Swift core: module Sxml, the merged archive, ARC and the test hooks (packet )

body.p: , after , , , , , , . Packet added Package.swift at the root and bindings/swift/ (module Sxml; the API of docs/tasks/phase-6.md, XPath half).

item.p: Linking: CSxmlHost is a system module whose module map is bindings/host/sxml_host.h itself, with link "sxml_host". No Swift-specific C.

On Linux, bindings/swift/CMakeLists.txt merges every static library sxml_host links (the shim, sxml, tree-sitter, the grammars, libmpdec) into one lib/libsxml_host.a with an ar -M script. The manifest then names one library, whatever sxml links.
The grammars are found through the global property SXML_GRAMMAR_LIBRARIES, because their link to sxml is deferred to the end of the root directory.

The manifest's include path (-Xcc -I include) and -L are unsafe flags, set only when SXML_HOST_LIBRARY_PATH is. A root package may use them. A package that depends on this one cannot, so it needs the XCFramework of 6.9.
ctest swift/linux runs swift test --disable-xctest -Xswiftc -warnings-as-errors with a scratch path in the build tree.
Under the sanitizer presets it adds --sanitize=address. swiftc has no -sanitize=undefined on Linux, but the ASan runtime has UBSan's handlers, so the -fno-sanitize-recover C code links and traps.
--disable-xctest: XCTest's empty run leaks objects of its own, which LeakSanitizer reports. The tests use Swift Testing.
Skipped with code 77 and a message when no swift is found (SXML_SWIFT, else PATH). Registered on Linux hosts only.
gold prints "Cannot export local symbol '__asan_...'" warnings at the ASan link. They are harmless.
API choices (defaults under ):

SxmlError.description is sxml's description, as the task file lists it, and so also the CustomStringConvertible text. message adds the code and location ("1:3: err:XPST0003: ..."), as the JavaScript message does.
Processor(... failingAllocationNumber: Int = 0) is public, as failingAllocationNumber is in the JavaScript options.
CollationData.bundled serves nothing until 6.8 adds the DUCET as a SwiftPM resource. It is then the one place to change.
Map keys of [String: XdmInput?] reach fn:parse-json in code point order: a Swift dictionary has no order of its own.
A Value inside an array or map is refused (SxmlUsageError.unsupportedInput). JSON-shaped data cannot hold it.
ResourceKind cases are camelCase with the JavaScript names as raw values. Status cases are camelCase with sxml_status's names as raw values.
Leak checks: a processor's deinit reports the allocations left to an internal leakObserver, which the tests set through @testable import. With ARC there is no dispose to call before the check.

Tests: 27 in Swift Testing. 24 have the names of test/package.test.ts. The two disposal tests are replaced by three ARC tests: "a value keeps its processor alive", "an expression keeps its processor alive", and "values that are released return their memory".
Toolchain: Swift 6.2 (swift-6.2-RELEASE, the Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 tarball from download.swift.org), Swift Testing 6.2, tools version 6.0, Swift 6 language mode.

For 6.9 (Apple): there, CSxmlHost becomes a binaryTarget (Sxml.xcframework, whose static library is also libsxml_host.a). The headers and the module map go into the XCFramework. Merge with libtool -static, not ar -M. Check swift test --sanitize=address --disable-xctest there; it has not been run on macOS.
